<thought>The dominant peak at m/z 180.042 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.035 Da. Matching this mass to possible formulas and considering the ~10 % M+1 isotopic intensity (≈9–10 carbons) points to C₉H₇O₄, whose exact mass is 179.034435 Da—within 0.6 mDa of the observed value. This fits the data best.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
